idempotency: Issue titles are the identity. Do not create a second issue with the same title.
apply: Requires LINEAR_API_KEY and an explicit apply command. Loading this file does not call Linear.

tasks.title: FB movement: keep opponent-facing footwork inside the ring
tasks.acceptance: Orthodox and southpaw still face the opponent, lateral input uses the actor yaw, and AFBRingBounds clamps the body. Existing camera framing stays.

tasks.title: FB combat: slip, duck, parry, and counter windows
tasks.acceptance: Defense changes server-owned contact results. A missed punch can be punished. Clients still submit intents only.

tasks.title: FB fighters: three weight-class presentation specs
tasks.acceptance: Lightweight, middleweight, and heavyweight specs validate, and hitboxes remain the canonical class capsule.

tasks.title: FB animation: named inbox and retarget review
tasks.acceptance: Clips use the FB_Scope_Category_Action_Variant names and fail validation until the skeleton and foot contact are reviewed.

tasks.title: FB damage: cosmetic bruising separate from authoritative health
tasks.acceptance: Sweat, bruise, swelling, and cut parameters do not decide knockdowns or wins.

tasks.title: FB net: two-client authoritative sparring smoke test
tasks.acceptance: A listen server and one client exchange intents. The server owns hits. No public ranked service.

tasks.title: FB training: heavy bag preserves the sparring roster
tasks.acceptance: Bag drills do not delete ring fighters or rewrite the broadcast camera.

tasks.title: FB career: records stay out of official ranked state
tasks.acceptance: Offline career results do not write player MMR or title eligibility.

tasks.title: FB UI: career menu from the local layout spec
tasks.acceptance: UMG uses the broadcast colors and spacing. Figma is linked only after a file key exists.

tasks.title: FB tests: contract suite and editor build evidence
tasks.acceptance: pytest for the golden contracts is recorded, and a gameplay claim cites a real FinalBellEditor build or an honest blocker.
